capabilities: Render d2 fenced code blocks as diagrams
Configure layout engine, theme, padding, and sketch mode
Set a custom path to the local d2 installation
extras: Requires D2 installed locally; the plugin searches common install locations and the system PATH, with a manual path setting for setups it can't find. A remote API option is planned but not yet available. Support questions are directed to the D2 Discord.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn D2 text scripts into rendered diagrams inside notes.

relations.evidence: currently this plugin calls your local installation of D2

summary: Renders D2 diagram-scripting code blocks into diagrams using a locally installed D2 CLI, with configurable layout, theme, and sketch mode.
